integrity: The closed-neighborhood packing condition forces gaps of at least three; the induced-edgeless isolation condition forbids uncovered runs of two, yielding gaps at most four. Boundary slack, cyclic marked-set counting, and componentwise multiplication provide the exact formulas.
scientific_limitations: Only finite simple graphs of maximum degree at most two are classified.
The enumeration counts all vertex subsets, without identifying automorphism-equivalent sets.
Exhaustive tests reach connected order 17 and all unlabelled component profiles through order 9; the universal theorem is proved symbolically.
Novelty is literature- and database-search-based, not a proof of absence of older alternate terminology.
title: Packing-isolating sets of all graphs of maximum degree two
